About the festival

Hundreds of small cities across India are poised on the edge of transformation: this is where the next phase of urbanisation will unfold.

Through this festival, we will explore and reimagine small cities as living systems that evolve through interconnected decisions. Because when the different aspects of the city are addressed together, the result is bigger than just individual improvements: it is transformative.

Not just another climate convening

01

Collective Intelligence

Participatory learning clinics with key partners working on cities to exchange knowledge, build solutions, and shape futures

02

Climate as Culture

Narrative sprints, theatre plays, storybuilding, music and film screenings to highlight how climate is changing our way of being

03

City and the Citizen

Engaging one of the most important stakeholders of the city – its citizens, through walks, games and more

04

City Governance and Leadership

Engaging city officials, mayors and decision makers in shaping the future of cities.

Panjim

A gathering for the future of our small cities

Small and medium cities of India are not merely immature versions of large metros. They are living urban systems with their own histories, cultures, ecologies, and patterns of growth. Like evolving organisms, they are growing through countless interactions between people, institutions, infrastructure, nature, and economies.

Through this festival, we hope to spark a chain reaction that transforms the networks, narratives, and relationships that define our cities, creating a better quality of life than our current urban systems offer.
